name: Asuka Mirai
source: A second year at Hibari High and [url=/c3882]You's[/url] classmate. He is the sole member of the Occult Circle until he effortlessly succeeds in recruiting [url=/c3907]Chinami[/url]. He often gets into disagreements with [url=/c3910]Asuho[/url]. He has a tendency to take pictures of [url=/c3938]Kosame[/url] flirting with [url=/c3932]Komomo[/url], and when he brags about it to You, Komomo crushes his camera under her foot. [spoiler] He later tells [url=/c3882]You[/url] about his sister that went missing years ago. [/spoiler]
